answer: Sibling keys stay cheap if they borrow one already-cleared collateral file. The applicant locks 19 POA for 4 epochs and cuts a pearl = sm3(pubkey||nacre_salt)[:13]. A spiral walk, slot k=(salt xor checkpoint + 13*k*k) mod roster, names four foreign perches 7h apart, kin skipped. At perch k a falcon relay—no shared funder in 4 epochs—hmac-signs (pearl||perch_pk||root_k) for 0.62 POA; root_k merklizes 7 fresh receipts. Bond refunds if all four land. Peers recompute the walk and signatures. A reused pearl, self-picked perch, or missed relay slashes 30% to that relay and freezes the salt 5 epochs.
